notes: Ownership moment: an evening drive that begins in town, with passengers and bags settled in, and can continue into a longer journey; on a warm day the later seat-airflow beat adds a small pleasure. This is a general situation, not a claim about the customer. Keep the seven supplied stops in exactly their supplied order. Make the engine and gear-changing decision the largest beat; keep small comforts brief. Every stop has approved facts, so all are required even where subtopics have gaps. F002 permits an opening about Hyundai positioning the car for city use and longer runs; the registry supplies no grounded reputation hook. Driving handoff: the petrol engine offers a six-speed manual or IVT, diesel a six-speed manual or six-speed automatic, and turbo petrol a seven-speed DCT. Turbo/DCT is listed only for King, while King also offers other engines. Do not imply each trim offers every choice. Any F010–F012 driving language remains an attributed manufacturer description; F004 and F007 are specifications, not acceleration or loaded-climb proof. Modes and paddles have automatic-only feature rows for S(O), S(O) Knight, SX Premium, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; the current matrix has no S(O) Knight automatic combination and no SX automatic. Auto hold is unavailable on E, EX, EX(O) and SX; automatic-only on S(O), S(O) Knight and SX Premium; standard on King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, with the S(O) Knight combination caveat retained. Explain holding while stationary without a guarantee on every surface. Wheels: R16 on E, EX and EX(O); R17 on S(O), SX and SX Premium; R18 on S(O) Knight, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. Their sizes do not prove comfort or clearance. Space: split rear seats, rear vents, rear armrest and front armrest storage are standard; reclining rear seats start S(O), rear sunshade starts EX(O), and sliding front armrest operation is only King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. The split-seat USP promises flexibility between passengers and bags, not a quantity of luggage or guaranteed comfort. Safety: airbags, stability control, disc brakes, hill-start assistance, tyre-pressure monitoring and rear parking sensors are standard. The airbag USP is narrow and does not imply the same complete safety equipment or crash performance at every price. Hill-start assistance is an aid with the driver responsible. Extra driving assistance is King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; adaptive stop-go is automatic-only within those trims. Surround and blind-spot cameras start SX Premium without extending the other assistance features to SX Premium. Whenever assistance is described, retain F034: safe attentive driving remains necessary, effectiveness varies and intervention is not guaranteed. Cabin: separate front temperature settings start S(O). The two stated screens are each 26.03 cm (10.25 inches) and start SX; preserve the exact size. Bluelink starts SX with three complimentary years and dependence on power and network coverage. Alexa Home to Car starts SX and uses separate Alexa hardware; this registry does not establish phone-app engine start. Phone mirroring starts EX; SX and above require a wired-to-wireless adapter and compatible devices. Both front power seats and driver memory apply to King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; driver power adjustment separately starts SX Premium. Small comforts: front-seat airflow and Bose sound start SX Premium; panoramic roof starts EX(O), with voice operation from SX. Describe airflow through cushions without a cabin-cooling time or refrigerated-air promise, and voice roof operation without a safety benefit. Driver-side welcome lamps start SX; both sides apply to King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. Glove-box cooling starts S(O). The real supplied image IDs alone are permitted: turbo and diesel pictures show those engines, the lane picture shows lane detection, and a dashboard picture cannot substitute for an engine. The rear table visible in im_pdf_21bb72b4fd2c922acfa9 has no approved feature fact and should not be promoted. Missing literal feature pictures remain gaps even when facts support narration. Ownership: the supplied entry ex-showroom amount belongs to the 19 September 2026 compilation and conflicts with another amount on the same page; do not present it as a verified current price. Tax, registration and insurance are added locally and a dealer quote is required. Up to seven years extended warranty applies only to petrol and is paid separately; exact coverage and price remain unknown. Fact IDs under an unknown objection provide partial context only, not a complete answer.
